title: Dissent
description: A single commissioner's objection. One admissible dissent voids the entire adjudication. The remediation_condition is mandatory and load-bearing: a dissent without an objectively checkable clearance condition is an unfalsifiable objection, and ten agents empowered to raise unfalsifiable objections never converge.

generation.description: Which instance generation of this seat raised it. Successors inherit open dissents.

dossier_hash.description: The sealed record this vote was cast against. A dissent against a stale dossier is inadmissible.

jurisdiction.description: Must match the seat's assigned jurisdiction. Out-of-jurisdiction dissents are ruled void by the Chair.

failure_statement.description: What breaks, for whom, under what input or condition. Not a preference, not a suggestion.

evidence.description: At least one citation. Unsupported dissents are void.

remediation_condition.description: "This dissent clears when X is true." Must be objectively checkable. Functions as an additional acceptance criterion.

severity_note.description: Advisory only. All admissible dissents block equally — there is no partial acceptance.

routed_to.description: Stage assigned by the root-cause classifier: refiner, architect, analyst, test_engineer, decomposer.

cleared_by.description: Only the issuing seat or its successor may clear. Never the remediating agent, the Orchestrator, or another commissioner.

dispute.description: Raised by a remediating agent asserting the dissent is itself wrong. Resolved by human arbitration; the outcome feeds the seat's calibration record.

contradicts.description: Ids of open dissents whose remediation conditions cannot simultaneously hold. Detected by the Chair; routes straight to human arbitration without spending a remediation attempt.
